                         FINANCE COMMITTEE

                       October 25, 2022 MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

     The monthly meeting of the City of Clarksville Finance Committee was called to order by
     Chairperson Streetman on Tuesday, October 25, 2022, at 4:30 p.m. in the City Hall
     Conference Room, 1 Public Square, Clarksville, Tennessee.

ATTENDANCE:

     PRESENT: Streetman, Holleman, Zacharias, Smith, Redd (arrived at 4:25)

FINANCE COMMITTEE ACTION
     1.   CPD Grant - Wellness Counselor Position


             Councilperson Redd made a motion to approve. The motion was seconded by
             Councilperson Holleman. A voice vote was taken:

             AYE: Streetman, Holleman, Redd, Smith, Zacharias

             The motion Passed
